Good: skippable + concatenated frames work with read_across_frames=True. FrameParameters has content_size ✓.

Now let me test: does stream_reader detect a corrupt checksum? And truncation?

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps')
import zstandard as zstd, io
cctx=zstd.ZstdCompressor(write_checksum=True, write_content_size=True)
data=b'hello world '*100
f=cctx.compress(data)
# corrupt checksum byte
bad=bytearray(f); bad[-1]^=0xff
try:
    r=zstd.ZstdDecompressor().stream_reader(io.BytesIO(bytes(bad)), read_across_frames=True)
    print('read:',len(r.read()))
except zstd.ZstdError as e:
    print('ZstdError:',e)
# truncation
try:
    r=zstd.ZstdDecompressor().stream_reader(io.BytesIO(f[:-5]), read_across_frames=True)
    print('trunc read:',len(r.read()))
except zstd.ZstdError as e:
    print('trunc ZstdError:',e)
# content size mismatch
import zstandard
p=zstd.ZstdCompressor(write_content_size=False).compress(data)
try:
    r=zstd.ZstdDecompressor().stream_reader(io.BytesIO(p), read_across_frames=True)
    print('no-fcs read:',len(r.read()))
except zstd.ZstdError as e:
    print('ZstdError:',e)
"
